msg: Hello! So, put your fingers on the keys and keep them there. You may feel more comfortable with your right hand on k and space, while just your middle finger of your left hand is on the s key. There will be breaks, don't worry. Randomize k and s all you want, or just press one of them the entire time, though that might get boring. And, hey, if you have an itch and need to take one hand off the keyboard, it's pretty easy to keep going. Remember to press space on the basket, it doesn't do it itself! And, once again, remember there will be breaks. It won't be forever. Hope you have fun!
